I so appreciate the wisdom from this wonderful young person.

op: @recess_therapy

Video

I got some wise words from Rep. Clyburn today, who reminded me that the true way out of this nightmare is Americans going to the polls in massive numbers so that we regain control of Congress.

Video

Americans are losing healthcare because they can’t afford it, they’re struggling to pay the rent or mortgage, their prescription drugs, and then they look up and see a President focused on grifting not governing.

Video

In a world with too much indiscriminate meanness, I love this deliberate kindness. 

These family rules should be our rules too.

op: @natestone84

Video

No one is above the law, and corruption all too easily begets authoritarianism. We have to stand against it. 

op: @annaconnellyiscool

Video

Senator Padilla is absolutely right: the people who tried to overthrow our government and attacked police don’t deserve a taxpayer-funded payout. We’ll keep fighting to ensure this never happens.

op: @alexpadilla4ca

Video

How much is Trump’s reckless and unauthorized war costing Americans? The estimates are shocking:
$29 billion of our tax dollars that could have gone to working families healthcare, childcare, or education
$40 billion directly out of your wallet to pay for higher gas prices

op: @financialtimes

Video
Donald Trump isn’t governing, he is grifting.

George Floyd’s murder shook the conscience of our nation and the world. The collective pain inspired a powerful movement for justice and reform. We must keep pushing until we truly have equal justice for all.

This Memorial Day, we honor the brave men and women who made the ultimate sacrifice for our nation. We will never be able to repay the debt we owe them and their families, so we must instead carry the ideals they died for–Freedom, Liberty, and Justice–forward, every single day.

In moments of darkness, we need to let our light shine brightest.

Video

I made this video four years ago in the aftermath of my brother Cary’s stroke. I’m in awe of how far he has come in the years since. Cary’s strength, resilience, and spirit continue to inspire me every single day.

Grateful for the love and support of my brothers on this Brothers Day!

Video

The American people believe the system is rigged, we have to recognize that pain and lead a way out of it.

Video
You can’t make this up. Trump’s policy has enriched himself while working Americans are sicker and poorer since he took power.

I love Jersey.

Video

Trump’s billion dollar slush fund is one of the most brazen acts of corruption in modern history.

We cannot normalize this level of self-dealing and greed, and we must make every American aware how he is using OUR tax dollars for his own corrupt schemes. 

op: @katiecouric

Video

This Ebola outbreak is heartbreaking and infuriating. Thanks to Trump’s reckless leadership, we’re seeing the devastating consequences of gutting USAID and slashing global health programs — the very systems designed to keep us safe. 

Because of these thoughtless cuts, America is less prepared for public health emergencies like this outbreak.

op: @AaronParnas

Video

We can create so much joy for our communities just by expanding our definition of generosity and kindness.

Video

Sportsmanship. Grace. Kindness. On the field and in life may we all show it more.

Video

Senator Warnock lays it plain.

op: @MSNowNews
